description: Traffic statistics for a time range. Buckets are unix minutes for 1h and 24h, unix hours for 7d and 30d

error_rate.description: Share of 4xx and 5xx responses (0 without requests)

visitors.description: Unique visitors (distinct visitor hashes per host and day). Only present when unique visitors are counted. For range 1h the count is for the current UTC day, for the other ranges from the UTC day the range starts on

visitors_capped.description: The per host and day visitor limit was reached in the selection, so visitors is a lower bound (at least). Stays true for a day whose limit was raised later. Only present when unique visitors are counted

series.description: Every bucket of the range, oldest first, missing buckets are zero

by_class.description: Requests per status class: 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx always, other when present

top_hosts.description: Requests per NPMpro host (all its domain names together), sorted by requests. host_type deleted: a stored domain name no host lists any more (removed name or deleted host), one entry per name. host_type other: requests to names no host lists (default site, IPs)

host_id.description: Id of the proxy, redirection or 404 host, null for deleted and other

name.description: First domain name of the host, the stored name for deleted, _other for other

domain_names.description: All domain names of the host (lower-cased), the stored name for deleted, empty for other

visitors.description: Unique visitors of this entry, only present when unique visitors are counted. For range 1h the count is for the current UTC day, for the other ranges from the UTC day the range starts on

visitors_capped.description: The visitor limit was reached, so visitors is a lower bound (at least). Only present when unique visitors are counted

asn.description: AS number, 0 for networks over the per host and hour limit

top_ips.description: Only present when visitor IPs are shown; "other" collects IPs over the per host and hour limit

top_404_paths.description: Only present while missing pages are tracked (setting traffic_missing_paths): the most requested paths of 404 and 410 responses of proxy and redirection hosts in the range (1h and 24h: whole hours from the range's first hour, like the other top lists; 7d and 30d: whole UTC days, because rows older than two days are kept per day), sorted by requests. Query strings are never stored; emails read :email, ID and token segments :id; "(other)" collects paths over the limit of 500 per domain name and day or 50,000 per day over all names

countries.description: Requests per country code (-- when unknown), all countries of the range, sorted by requests descending, for the map

recent.description: The newest requests, newest first, kept in memory only (empty after a restart, cleared when traffic statistics are switched off; NPMpro's own requests are not recorded). For a host filter the requests of that host, otherwise of all hosts; independent of the range

host_id.description: Id of the proxy, redirection or 404 host, null for deleted and other

name.description: First domain name of the host, the stored name for deleted, _other for other

method.description: Request method as logged, - when the request line is malformed

path.description: Request path without query string and fragment, at most 200 characters, empty when the request line is malformed

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, null when unknown or without a GeoIP database

ip.description: Client IP, only present when visitor IPs are shown

geoip.description: A GeoLite2 Country or ASN database is loaded

skipped_lines.description: Access log lines that could not be parsed since the backend started

dropped_requests.description: Requests dropped because the database could not be written for 10 minutes, since the backend started

visitors_error.description: Why visitors cannot be counted right now (the visitor key could not be loaded), null otherwise
